browserIntegration.usage: Mount during pending work; remove at completion. Transparent 740:700 aspect. Methods play(), pause(), replay(); speed 0.1–4 (default 1); paused and label attributes. components.name: Gradient profile avatar
components.status: Selected reusable browser and SwiftUI pieces. Maximum four including you; no native app integration.

browserIntegration.usage: Assign .person for a single profile, .members for stack/lead; stable id, name, initials, photoURL, optional gradientIndex and self. JSON person/members attributes also accepted. size 24–96, default36. lead-id optional. Photo falls back to deterministic varied gradient. FNV-1a over UTF-8 id; same palettes/algorithm as SwiftUI. Stack/lead render max4; host enforces membership. Wrap decorative piece in a labelled 44-point button when interactive. Lead stays inside compact/widget margins. Saved portraits accept faceStyle and explicit gradientIndex 0–11; photo overrides the face. The host resolves confirmed identities with TodayPartyAvatars.setIdentityResolver. See PROFILE-IDENTITY.md. Individual saved faces animate using the shared face renderer; still attribute freezes them. Stacks/lead stay still. Reduced motion and offscreen/background suspension are respected.

nativeIntegration.usage: TodayPartyAvatars.swift exposes TodayPartyMember, TodayProfileAvatar, TodayAvatarStack, TodayLeadAvatar and TodayAvatarPalette. Stable IDs required; never hashValue or array-position colors. See PARTY-AVATARS.md. Include all three swiftSource files; TodayPartyMember accepts faceStyle and photoData. Optional TodayProfileIdentity.swift shares confirmed identity across routes.
